// diagnostic

E0634

The effect family case `{family}.{member}` carries a payload

What

The effect family case `{family}.{member}` carries a payload

Why

An effect family's cases are effect names, which a row writes as `-[{family}.{member}]>`; a name carries no value

Fix

Remove the payload from `{member}`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0634: tests/ui/effects/effect_family_case_with_payload.stderr.

Error [jet.EffectCaseWithPayload]: The effect family case `Bucket.Named` carries a payload
